svg.title: The Alignment Tax — arXiv:2603.24124
svg.desc: Animated illustration: sampled responses from a base model fall into five semantic clusters; after DPO alignment they collapse into one. 40–79% of questions collapse to a single semantic cluster; DPO is the cause, not SFT; token entropy survives.

g.text: Response Homogenization in Aligned LLMs and Its Implications for Uncertainty Estimation

is what causes the collapse — SFT does not
